entity: Roosevelt Cayman Asset Company's share of Puerto Rico federal foreclosures and its default-judgment outcomes
what_we_add: the counts: about 1,130 cases over 2015-25 and 52% ending in default judgment vs 37% for other filers
why: NotiCel, Hedge Clippers and The Intercept all name Roosevelt Cayman as the dominant federal-court foreclosure filer and note its default-judgment motions - same finding, same direction. No source has the 10-year case count or the default-rate comparison.
